arm: Franka Emika Panda (single arm for Bowl; two arms for Pancake and Shirt)
success_criterion: task-specific, defined ahead of time by the behavior designer (e.g. energy-bar task: 'Energy bar is on the wooden tray and the tray is on the table'; collisions not counted as failures)
headline_metric: success rate, recommended to be reported as a Bayesian posterior over the Bernoulli success probability rather than a point estimate
human_data: human teleoperation demonstrations (task-specific, e.g. 154 for Bowl)
